title: T2 golden 65000ms.png blesses a crisis banner rendering a literal '?' — the em-dash is byte-truncated by draw_text_c
evidence: app/render/crisis.odin:61: `title = fmt.aprintf("!!  %s: %s ACTIVE — bundle %d (pipe %d)",` — xxd of that line: `2573 2041 4354 4956 4520 e280 9420 6275` ("ACTIVE " + U+2014 em-dash + " bu"). app/render/view.odin:413-415: `for ch in txt { append(&cbuf, u8(ch)) }` — the rune-to-byte truncation. Pixel read of the blessed 65000ms.png (4 independent vision passes incl. an 8x crop of the glyph position between "ACTIVE" and "bundle"): transcribes "E ? bundle 1 (pipe 1)" and "A question mark ?" — a literal '?' where the em-dash was intended.
detail: The sole active-crisis pixel capture pins a banner rendering '?' instead of '—' (truncated non-ASCII rune). The harness asserts this buggy output as golden, so the defect is enshrined and undetectable by the suite.
recommended_fix: Replace the U+2014 em-dash with an ASCII '-' in both crisis.odin title formats; re-bless surge 65000ms.png deliberately; optionally assert ASCII-only strings in draw_text_c.
